reviews.text: This place takes great care of my dog, the vet is always so good at explaining anything and making sure we understand any issues our little guy is having and making recommendations for his care. Or dog is quite old so plenty of new health issues coming up.
Thank you for your positive review - we appreciate you taking the time and can't wait to see you again!
No urgency or care to call clients back regarding the health of their pets that were seen there. Unprofessional and unacceptable — some vet office. Not worth your time or money.
Office manager has yet to call me back after several messages left— I guess NO urgency for pets. This place has horrible service now.

They did a great job of treating my young dog for heartworms, ringworms, and fleas when I first got her (she was in bad shape), thought the cremation of two of my kitties (after 18 & 20 years) was a bit pricey at $350 each.

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

I truly cannot say enough wonderful things about this veterinary office and their entire staff. We have been bringing all of our dogs here for over five years, and the care, compassion, and kindness they have shown our family and our fur babies has always been exceptional.

I was especially touched by the empathy and compassion they showed us during one of the hardest moments a pet owner can face—saying goodbye to our sweet Bella. The way they handled her euthanasia and cremation with such gentleness, dignity, respect, and genuine care meant more to our family than I could ever fully put into words. Their compassion went above and beyond, and it is something I will never forget.

That same level of care continues with the fur babies we still have with us. They don’t treat our dogs like just another appointment or another patient. They understand that they are members of our family, and they care for them that way.

We no longer live close to the office, but that doesn’t matter—we will happily drive across town because finding people you trust with your animals is worth the drive. After more than five years, they have earned our complete trust, and as long as we have dogs—which will absolutely be for the rest of our lives—this is where we will bring them.

Thank you to every single member of the staff for the love, patience, compassion, and care you have given our family over the years, and especially for the kindness you showed us and our precious Bella when we needed it most. You made an incredibly painful goodbye just a little easier, and our family will always be grateful. ❤️🐾

If you’re looking for a veterinary office that will truly care about your animals AND the people who love them, I cannot recommend them highly enough.

I’ve been taking my dog to this clinic for several years, so I’m especially disappointed by our most recent visit.

We brought her in because she has several lumps that we wanted evaluated. The veterinarian examined them and said they were probably lipomas. I explained that one of the lumps had been checked a couple of years ago and had come back clear, but that she now has several more, including some that have become quite large. I was hoping to discuss whether they should be sampled or monitored more closely.

Instead, the conversation quickly shifted toward a dental cleaning promotion they are running throughout August. I was told that samples of the lumps could be taken while she was under anesthesia for the dental procedure. I was also told that her teeth looked good, but that there could potentially be buildup under the gums in the back teeth. I asked about having her nails trimmed, something the clinic has done for her several times before, and was told that because her nails are black, the best option would be to do them while she was under anesthesia for the dental cleaning.

At that point, I honestly felt less like I was having a conversation with my veterinarian about my dog’s health and more like I was being sold a package at a car dealership. The dental cleaning was presented as the best option, even though I had not brought my dog in because of a dental problem. I was ultimately given a quote of around $1,800 for everything.

What bothers me most is feeling that, in order to have the care and diagnostic work I actually came in for, I first needed to agree to an expensive dental procedure. I understand that dental health is important for dogs, and I have absolutely no problem paying for appropriate veterinary care. What I do have a problem with is feeling pressured into an elective procedure in order to address the original reason for my visit.

After several years of taking my dog here, this experience has unfortunately left me uncomfortable enough that I now feel the need to seek a second opinion and likely find another veterinary clinic. I really hope the clinic takes this feedback seriously, because the way this visit was handled left me feeling disappointed rather than cared for.

I couldn't be more disappointed in this vet. I scooped up an emaciated, flea covered cat who was completely dehydrated and listless. Brought him home and got him to eat and drink. Then I took him to this place to get checked out, get flea treatment, vaccines, etc. They found a microchip, so they found the original owners. These "owners" reported they went out of town, left the cat outside (in the Houston heat during the summer), came back and he was missing. The vet's assertion is that laws protect pet owners and returning the cat is fine! They're forgetting that there are also laws that are supposed to protect animals from neglect and abuse.  Handing an animal over to people who left them outside in the summer only to end up half-alive and emaciated is pathetic. We're finding a new vet and you should too.

I wanted to take a moment to recognize Adonia for the exceptional customer service she provides at West Houston Veterinary Medical Associates.

I’ve had the pleasure of working with Adonia on several occasions, most recently after adopting two kittens, and every single experience has been outstanding. She is incredibly knowledgeable, patient, friendly, and genuinely caring. No matter how many questions I have, she takes the time to listen, explain everything thoroughly, and make sure I feel comfortable before ending the conversation.

What impresses me most is her consistency. It’s not just that she provides excellent service once in a while—she delivers it every single time. She makes you feel heard, valued, and confident that both you and your pets are receiving the very best care. That kind of dedication and compassion is rare these days.

Adonia is truly a tremendous asset to West Houston Veterinary Medical Associates. She represents the practice with professionalism, kindness, and genuine compassion, and she deserves to be recognized for the incredible work she does. Thank you, Adonia, for always going above and beyond. You make a lasting impression, and it is sincerely appreciated.

If I could give them 0 stars I would. My family’s dog went to them for years & saw them several times a year, due to some skin allergies he suffered from. Within those years, they overlooked a respiratory issue he had, though my parents brought it to their attention. This weekend, after a visit to this vet, where they swore nothing serious was going on (and charged nearly $1,000 for the visit), our beloved dog passed away the next day at an emergency clinic where they said he must have had this issue for years. Completely blindsided by this, since he was CONSTANTLY under this vets supervision. If you care about your pets long term wellbeing, I would strongly advise to take your pet elsewhere.

Update ** to make matters even worse, once hearing of the passing of our dog, they simply texted back saying they’ve updated their records. Truly sick and twisted individuals at this practice. Stay far away.
The new AI “help bot” is infuriating.
Thank you for your positive review - we appreciate you taking the time and can't wait to see you again!

We was referred by our neighbor about  this vet!So we took our 14 yr old beagle mix to get a wellness check  due to losing weight, wound on his face  and fainted and was giving oxygen  and to find out the heart break news that he has liver mass via assessment and ultrasound(mass)and Dr.T is wonderful he spoke to my husband and about choices .NGL I was  😩😭😭😭😭 we are like home he just seemed in good health via labs w/another vet prior earlier this year and now we are  coming to terms to  give our fur baby a peaceful journey home😭!Holding back tears as I write this! PS Savannah the receptionist was awesome! My fur baby nurse ( I think was Shawn sorry if you’re reading this and I forgot your name)was helpful as well!

Go someplace else. Avoid this place at all costs. The receptionist posing as the manager admitted that they did a bait and switch.  We scheduled a simple nail clipping for our bunny and when we got there we were told that we would have to pay for a full exam before they would agree to cut our bunnies nails.  The receptionist in charge, had zero empathy and did not care at all.  How a vet could employ such an uncaring and apparently challenged individual is probably endemic to the practice.   Go elsewhere.

Fresh smell, clean and welcoming from the first step through the doors. The team is helpful and caring. Thank you Technician Jamie and Dr.McDonnell for your A+ care and expertise with my fur-baby. Bandit's post acupunture smile - speaks volumes to his comfort and his "Frenchie" snorts say Happy FriYay!

I had to bring my fur baby in because she was not feeling well. The staff was very kind and compassionate, they took really good care of my Bibi and were able to find out what was wrong with her. Now my girl is back to feeling better than ever!
Thank you for your positive review - we appreciate you taking the time and can't wait to see you again!
Excellent!

From the moment we walked into West Houston VMA, we felt welcome and safe. From the front desk receptionists to the nurses to the doctor, every person we encountered was kind, welcoming, helpful, and knowledgeable. We were referred from another doctor and were unsure of going to a new place after a negative experience somewhere else, but 10/10 I would recommend WHVMA and Dr. Gochenour.
The best place for ours baby's
Everything went smoothly, highly recommend

If there were 10 stars, I would give 10 out of 10.

I just picked up my dog Sausage after surgery and got home, and the very first thing I wanted to do was write a review because this place is truly amazing and highly recommended.

I was referred by other pet parents in the community and was fortunate to meet Dr. G regarding a lump on my dog’s back. After a thorough examination, Dr. G quickly laid out a clear treatment plan and explained everything to me with great patience and care. I had been comparing this plan with the one proposed by another vet, and Dr. G’s approach made much more sense to me both medically and practically.

On top of that, the entire office staff, from the front desk ladies to the nurses, are incredibly sweet and kind. A special shout-out to Breyn, my GS mix dog is usually very sensitive and cautious around strangers. BUT he immediately trusted her and followed her around without even looking back at me. He could absolutely sensed her kindness and gentle heart. She even took extra time to trim my dog's toenails short so he wouldn't scratch the suture after the surgery. She is simply incredible!

Thank you for taking such wonderful care of my dog and helping him woof happily again! I truly wish every pet parents could experience this level of care for their pets.

We had such a great experience here from start to finish.

Annette (the GM) was amazing from the moment we walked in. She was kind, knowledgeable, and incredibly patient. Even though they were short-staffed, she personally added us to the queue and did our intake to help keep things moving: total team-player energy with true white-glove care. She was so gentle and reassuring with my 8-year-old Pomeranian, Camila, who had been limping on and off for almost a month. We were really worried she might have fractured her right paw, so walking into a calm, caring environment made all the difference.

Dr. McDonnell was just as wonderful. She examined Camila, took X-rays, and didn’t just stop at the obvious issue. She actually caught a few additional things that hadn’t shown up in Camila’s previous X-ray and ultrasound done in Canada. She called us back quickly with results, explained everything clearly, and walked us through next steps. The fact that she looked beyond just the paw and thought about Camila’s overall health really meant a lot.

You can tell this team genuinely cares. We never felt rushed, brushed off, or left with unanswered questions. So grateful for the care Camila received -highly recommend this clinic if you want vets who truly go the extra mile!

I can’t say enough amazing things about this crew. My experience with all the staff was amazing.  The front staff was very attentive and welcoming, great job! Dr. G was amazing with my senior cat, he answered all my questions and created a plan for my cat! He’s very knowledgeable and skilled and I  would highly recommend anyone to him. Great job!

Staff was so kind and helpful my cat had passed right before I got there when I walked in crying person at front asked me if I was ok I said no I think she passed she got up to her to back to have checked immediately  which made me feel good that they' would take such quick action as if she may be saved. They treated me so kind all the staff are they truly care about people and there pets.
Thank you for your positive review - we appreciate you taking the time and can't wait to see you again!

Dr. McDonnell and Sean were great. We had a pretty poor experience with the Vet we were using after my puppy ended up needing stitches  and needed to find a new vet. Although the office was on the other side of town, it was well worth the drive. She was very informative and allowed me ample opportunity to ask questions. The stitches appeared to very well done. And most importantly I felt Her and her staff genuinely cared about the well being of my pup. I couldn’t recommend them enough.

This place has some of the most empathetic and caring staff. I have been bringing my pets here for a few years and will continue to do so. They have always treated my pets wonderfully. I 100% recommend this place.
Always feel like my fur baby is taken care of when we visit! They are usually able to get us squeezed in same week (or sometimes even same day)!
Polite, knowledgeable reception and technical staff. Multiple specialized diagnostic and treatment methods available. Excellent veterinary staff.
Good service, professional, reliable and friendly service. My dog is very happy with Doctor and technician.
Excellent care from Dr Tonking and staff. Dogs love him and over years he has gained my complete trust and respect.
They are the most friendly and polite people to deal with and the doctors are very talented.

I highly recommend WHVMA. I have been bringing my dogs here for 13 years. The doctors and staff are excellent, knowledgeable, professional, kind, gentle and most of all compassionate. They answer all my questions and provide a possible treatment plan for my pets.

When you have a sick animal, you get stressed and this clinic made everything much less stressful. They were able to take our dog in early in the morning and kept her till doctor got there, they were very helpful and our dog is feeling much better!
Lovely staff, they have a low cost vaccine and wellness option that is very affordable. They really treat pets as family members.

I called yesterday because I wanted to be a potential new customer but unfortunately I am not anymore due to a receptionist with the British accent being rude to me. She was very impatient and rude and wanted to hang up fast.  This place is horrible for customer service. After  my experience I will not be coming here and apparently a lot of people have the same issue with the same person after reading yelp reviews.

Extremely unprofessional Doctor cannot control herself, 0 bedside manner. Expect if you ask for an explanation she will raise her voice to almost yelling and belittle you. RUDE. They also will not stop spamming my email, they will not stop emailing even when requested.

I had a dog that needed put down due to quality of life. The doctor wanted to put the dog on Prozac. The dog was already on pain meds, and anxiety medicine and have behavioral issues due to the pain the animal was in. Always get another option. I felt like I was treating like a dollar bill, and not a loving pet owner!

I live 40 minutes away from your clinic, and from day one, I have trusted you to care for my beloved dog. During our most recent visit, my dog sustained a severe burn on his back, which we discovered the following day. We had to rush him to the emergency hospital due to the seriousness of the injury.

The following Monday, we returned to your clinic, hoping for an explanation and accountability. Unfortunately, we were met with a complete lack of responsibility and empathy. No one accepted fault, and the response we received was to simply wash your hands of the situation. There was no offer to help with the emergency medical expenses, and no compassion shown for the pain and trauma my dog — a cherished member of our family — is going through.

What’s even more concerning is that the personnel responsible was not present to provide any clarification or explanation. Is it not unusual for the person in charge to be unavailable during such a critical matter?

We entrusted you with the well-being of our pet, giving you 110% of our trust — even choosing your clinic over another one just five minutes from our home. And this is the result? My dog is in pain, and we are left heartbroken watching him suffer through something that could have been prevented.

This experience has been deeply disappointing and distressing. It is truly unfortunate to receive this level of service after placing so much trust in your care.

This is the best vet I could have found. When I brought Max in, he was in pretty bad shape from an unfortunate incident that occurred at another vet office, and I was frustrated and distraught. Everyone here took incredible care of my dog, and they took great care of me too as his human.
Clean facility. Courteous, professional, and friendly staff.

It has taken this office over three weeks to respond regarding my cat’s asthma medication. I’ve had to call three separate times, and each time I was told someone would call me back but no one has. For a serious health condition like asthma, this level of delay and disregard is unacceptable especially considering how expensive their services are. I strongly urge others to seek care elsewhere to avoid the same frustration. I will continue to follow up until the prescription they promised for my cat is finally fulfilled.

Follow up response.

I am currently on the line with the office and they have once again told me that there is no medication on file and nothing was prescribed. The rep that I spoke with read out the notes on my cats case  “the vet spoke with one receptionist to tell another receptionist to order the medication.” The rep did not get a notice and nothing has been ordered. If you value your pets life or your garden earned money. Go somewhere else. Once I have the prescription I will be going elsewhere.

We brought our dog here as she was having some issues with her allergies. They prescribed her Apouqel, which we are familiar with as we have had dogs on it in the past. They prescribed her two 5.4mg tablets a day, which is odd because the manufacturer of Apoquel does not recommend giving two 5.4mg tablets for her weight. Per the chart below, the manufacturer of Apoquel recommends doing half of a 16mg pill. As the cost of Apoquel is per pill and the amount does not change per the number of milligrams in the pill, if I were to give my dog two 5.4mg a day, it would cost me 4 times as much as giving half a 16mg pill.
Great staff and very professional customer service! I highly recommend them to anyone!
Bo is doing a lot better...Thanks to West Houston Veterinary Medical
Everyone at the front desk is really nice and friendly, specially Alex! You can tell that the vet and nurses there really care about animals, I know my 2 cats are in good hands there!

We’ve had nothing but amazing experiences at west Houston vet clinic They’ve taken such good care of our animals — always kind, professional, and genuinely caring. You can tell they really love what they do.

A special shoutout to Emily — she was absolutely wonderful. She made us feel welcome from the moment we walked in and went above and beyond to make sure both we and our pets were comfortable and taken care of. It’s not easy finding people who treat your animals like their own, but Emily and the whole team did exactly that.

Highly recommend this clinic to anyone who wants top-notch care for their pets with a personal touch.

The absolute rudeness of the receptionists here is insane.. I just walked after being told there’s “no way” I had an appointment and that “ your wrong” even though I confirmed it in the app they make you use, the rudeness and lack of accountability for taking and not honoring appointments is not how to get loyal customers.  The Drs are fine but there’s plenty of other vets who won’t treat you like crap just for making an appointment they don’t want to honor.

The lady I spoke with about their cremation services, was extremely nice and helpful. Pricing was a little out of our range, however I would highly recommend them just by their pleasant customer service.
Careing crew, friendly

They take the time to explain everything clearly and always make my pet feel calm and safe. I trust them completely and feel so lucky to have found such a dedicated team. Highly recommended to any pet parent!
The vets are top notch and have saved several of our cats the had serious issues. They are compassionate and the office staff are friendly and helpful. My vets forever
The staff is friendly and accommodating. The facility is nice and they offer services that most vet clinics do not have. I highly recommend them! Thank you for taking care of my kitties!
Thank you for your positive review - we appreciate you taking the time and can't wait to see you again!
This is the best vet care I have had since moving to Houston in 1974!  The staff is wonderful!

The best vet spot I’ve been to. I really don’t think there’s another vet place I’d go to. They’re fast, knowledgeable, and are the most friendliest people I’ve met. Sad I had to move because comparing the place I go to now is nothing compared to WHVMA. God, I wish there were more places like this one.
Alex, thank you so much for your help. You helped us with our kitten. God bless you! Very professional in your work, congratulations!
We were helped by Alex and she was wonderful, very kind, and provided excellent service. She helped us with the travel process for our cat, Flora. God bless you, Alex 🙏🏻 …
We love WHVMA! So do our three cats. We drive from Fry road to get to you, passing many closer vets. Y'all are the best!
The young woman who attended to me didn't give me a clear answer to what I was requesting: attention for my pet.
Came in for a Bordetella shot with a nurse appointment. Was in and out within a couple of minutes! Very easy and efficient.

Front desk staff was super helpful on the phone and were quick to get us on the schedule for same day (thank goodness!). Sam was outstanding!! He was so calm and gentle with my nervous pup & explained everything as we went through the appointment. You can tell the team here loves what they do. The doc was very sweet and we were in and out with no complaints!
We are always thrilled to see happy clients! If there is anything else we can do for you, please reach out to us directly. See you soon!

I have been bringing our little ones here for a few years and the doctors and techs are great, but lately the staff has become very slow and inefficient.
Phone wait times are a little too long and medication orders are not timely.
Thank you for your positive review - we appreciate you taking the time and can't wait to see you again!

My dog was terrified to enter and the vet had to pull him into a room by a leash. I should have walked out. Never again.

The staff aren't just friendly. They're also professional at what they do which is to take care of animals the best they can. They communicate very well and always tell us to call if we have any questions.
Staff is friendly,  knowledgeable and compassionate.  They helped us through the very difficult loss of our 18 yr Dolce. They are providing excellent care of our other 2 fur babies.

I will start this by saying I am grateful that my cat is hopefully getting better and that Adonia really tried to help us. However, we waited over 2 hours to see a doctor for an ultrasound. The appt was at 12 and we showed up around 11:45 and waited. We kept being told the Dr G was on his way and he is always late. We were quoted by Dr Boyce that the ultrasound would be $140. The clinic decided that Dr G would be better at the ultrasound so they changed our doctor. They failed to mention that the ultrasound would now be $545. By the end of the vist on top of the $426 I paid 2 days before I now owed over $700. 2 days before when we saw Dr Boyce they took the office visit because it was not out into the estimate. This time though they would not fix the bill. My mother and I were shocked and extremely upset. Not everyone can afford that. I was allowed to pay the remaining $300 on another check but that was only because Adonia saw how upset we were and that we honestly did not have the money. Had I have known about the change in price we would not have done the test. She had all the symptoms of pancreatic issues but they didn't yest those levels until after the ultrasound. I guess the $545 was more important than the $30 blood test when neither doctor felt a blockage. I can't pay my bills this month including my car. I just hope my cat gets better. I have never had this happen at a clinic. I will drive to Sugar Land to see my regular vet.

We brought our dog as an emergency case. The vet was very thorough, explained us everything us about the treatment and got us an estimate. Only after we agreed, our dog was treated. They also said that follow ups are free. I loved that they didn’t make us wait at all and honored the appointment time. Also they waited beyond their closing time for us to pick up the dog. Treatment was not cheap but I am sure it would have far expensive if we went to emergency clinic

My experience with West Houston Veterinary Medical Associates leading up to my dog’s neutering surgery was absolutely terrible. It started with the technicians failing to show up on time for my scheduled appointment. They arrived over an hour late, which completely disrupted my day and refused to fit me in the same day, despite their own error. The practice itself had a strange smell, and to make matters worse, there were millipedes everywhere—completely unacceptable for a veterinary clinic.

Adonia, the front desk staff member, rescheduled my appointment and assured me that the technicians would arrive on time for the new date. She was extremely nice, professional, and genuinely apologetic. Unfortunately, despite her best efforts, the technicians were late again for the rescheduled appointment. Adonia attempted to resolve the issue, but her proposed solution was rejected by Annette, the Practice Manager, who didn’t even bother to speak with me directly. Instead, the Practice Manager trained Adonia on a task the licensed technicians were supposed to do and made her do more work. Adonia reviewed paperwork with me but I did not feel comfortable asking any questions because she was not a technician, and no technicians were to discuss in detail the protocols for my dog’s surgery.

The lack of intervention from management and their failure to address or fix the situation made it clear that this practice thrives in chaos and does not prioritize its clients or their pets. Despite my patience and providing Adonia with my contact information, I never received a follow-up call about my dog’s surgery. Despite this issue, Adonia genuinely seemed to care. No one else did. My experience with the vet himself was very brief and cold. No comforting bedside manner here.

I would not recommend this clinic to anyone. The level of disorganization, poor service, and lack of care for their clients is appalling. Stay far away from this place if you value your time and your pet’s well-being.

My two corgis have been receiving care at West Houston Veterinary Medical Associates for about 10 years.  While not the least expensive, the service here is extremely thorough with regular feed back from the very well trained staff.  Recommended.

We moved to Houston from Galveston, and have a vet in Galveston. My dog Daisy has been on heartworm medicine and has records of it, but this place refuses to refill without a heartworm test. I’ll drive an hour and a half to Galveston instead of a half a mile to this place. It is all about $$

I cannot say enough good things about this veterinary center. From the front desk staff to the Techs- To Dr. Gochenour (Sidenote:when I called a chain veterinary franchise -where I usually would take my cat, to get his records - A lady from the front desk there said she had worked with Dr. Gochenour for years and he’s amazing and very experienced-) everyone is so loving and supportive on how they treat you and your pet.

The people here genuinely care about animals, Most of them have animals themselves, and they really have a heart for animals and humans alike. My cat has an issue and he’s going under anesthesia today, but I feel safe and trust the team take care of him and whatever they need to do today. Will write an update after I get my kitty back.

UPDATE : Dr. Gochenour and Mr. Sheldon‘s nursing team did an amazing job with my kitty cat. they have a strict policy within Their practice that they don’t send animals home If they aren’t completely recovered. I also learned from Mr. Sheldon that animals don’t experience pain and surgeries the way we do is humans. They are actually tougher than us! 😂His debriefing of my cat’s surgery put me at ease. The nurse manager, Mr. Sheldon runs his team very attentively and mindfully. The medical staff here are highly intelligent and compassionate people.

Without a question I recommend this place to any pet owner who wants their animal to be treated with tender, loving care, and the highest quality of service.

Thank You WHVMA Team! ❤️😻

I feel welcomed and all staff care about my pets. I love that the receptionist will take some time and help me work through things. All staff members are friendly and kind with my pets. Despite the big staff I feel like everyone there cares about me and my fur babies. That’s so important to me. I feel welcomed every time I come in!

Very good grooming of our Aussie Shepherd - thanks!

Great customer and pet crew.
